note: International Phone defines a phone_international field type (varchar 256; preSave reformats to E.164 via the phone_international.validate service / libphonenumber), a country-aware widget phone_international_widget (settings initial_country [default PT], geolocation, preferred_countries, countries all/exclude/include, exclude_countries) and a formatter phone_international_formatter (valid -> tel: link, invalid -> plain text). One global setting: phone_international.settings.cdn (bool). Settings route phone_international.settings at /admin/config/phone_international (permission 'administer site configuration'). Drush command phone_international:plugin (aliases piplugin/pi-plugin) installs intl-tel-input locally. Medium cases read a real widget setting and the live cdn value; hard cases set a widget's default country and enable cdn, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: In the phone_international module, what field type, widget, and formatter does it provide, and what normalization happens to a phone number when it is saved?
evals.expected_output: Field type phone_international, default widget phone_international_widget (intl-tel-input country selector), default formatter phone_international_formatter (renders valid numbers as tel: links). On save, preSave() reformats the value to E.164 via the phone_international.validate service (libphonenumber).

evals.prompt: Which service does phone_international expose for validating and formatting phone numbers programmatically, and what are its methods?
evals.expected_output: The service phone_international.validate (ValidatingService, IsValidInterface): isValidNumber(string) returns bool via libphonenumber, and formatNumber(string) returns the number reformatted to E.164.

evals.prompt: How do I install the intl-tel-input JavaScript library locally for phone_international instead of using the CDN? Name the command.
evals.expected_output: Run the Drush command phone_international:plugin (aliases piplugin / pi-plugin), which downloads intl-tel-input into the libraries/ directory. Then set phone_international.settings.cdn = false to serve it locally.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an International Phone field named field_pi_known. Inspect the live form display and state the default (initial) country configured on its widget.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default, the field_pi_known component (widget phone_international_widget) has settings.initial_country = GB.

evals.prompt: On this site, is phone_international configured to load the intl-tel-input assets from a CDN? Inspect the live configuration and answer with the current value of the CDN setting.
evals.expected_output: phone_international.settings.cdn is true — the CDN option is enabled.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an International Phone field field_pi_task whose widget currently defaults to Portugal. Change the widget so that new phone inputs default to the United Kingdom (initial country GB). Apply the change to the live form display.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set the field_pi_task widget (phone_international_widget) settings.initial_country to 'GB' and save.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure phone_international to load the intl-tel-input assets from the CDN (enable the CDN option). Apply the change live.
evals.expected_output: Set phone_international.settings.cdn = TRUE (via the settings form at /admin/config/phone_international or config).
